description: Active shared subject, identity-reuse, alias, relationship and snapshot-locator contract for canonical onboarding and bounded source/fact access.
active_onboarding_rule: new durable subject allocation is limited to required_subject_types excluding compatibility_only_subject_types; provider and exchange aliases attach to real subjects through the alias contract
provider_alias_rule: provider codes, tickers, names and hashes are scoped aliases only; they cannot create confirmed FR internal IDs without independent identity evidence

identity_reuse_contract.rule: accepted scoped crosswalks may find an existing identity decision before allocation; an external identifier never derives a subject UUID

alias_contract.rule: aliases attach to an accepted subject, are scoped and effective-dated, and cannot allocate or replace a durable subject identity

relationship_contract.extension_rule: each accepted relationship type supplies a stable definition reference and provenance; Universe foundations add only relationships proved by their real financial objects

snapshot_locator_contract.membership_owner: snapshot_catalog plus partition_manifest in the same snapshot control SQLite
snapshot_locator_contract.lookup_key: snapshot_id + subject_type + subject_id + layer + optional metric/scope + time interval
snapshot_locator_contract.path_rule: relative paths and content hashes identify physical files; path or physical-domain names never determine Universe or subject identity
snapshot_locator_contract.incremental_rule: register only completed members proved by the same snapshot control manifest; inherit locators only when predecessor and successor manifests both prove the unchanged relative path and content hash; replace locators for changed partitions in the successor transaction
